data.scope: agent-supplied geometry to independent source BIM; no correction run or solver stage

source_geometry_self_consistency.scope: source geometry, contacts and explicit opening hosts

agent_assumptions: No elevation/section supplied: floor z=0, ceiling 3.0m, doors 0-2.1m, windows 0.9-2.7m are explicit assumptions, not drawing observations
Interior partitions drawn as thin double lines without thickness annotation; modeled as zero-thickness centrelines
Exterior footprint uses observed outer faces; 240mm exterior wall thickness annotated in plan
World frame: x east (0 at west outer face), y north (0 at south outer face), matching plan orientation
Door leaves/swings not encoded; operating states unknown
Plan spaces were compiled deterministically from the declared footprint and physical partition segments; no snapping, extension, clipping, or inferred partition was applied.
unresolved: Furniture, door-swing arcs and text ignored as structure per observation of full wall paths
Corridor mouth aperture (x 408-451) carries double-leaf cyan marks; encoded as one 1.19m double door
No vertical dimension evidence at all; all heights are assumed
Interior partition thickness (drawn ~150-200mm double-line, unannotated) approximated as zero
Pixel-to-world calibration was supplied by the caller and was not independently verified.

source_validation.scope: source geometry, contacts and explicit opening hosts

plan_compilation.basis: Calibration from original dimension chains: top chain 540+1600+2520+4800+540=10000mm and left chain 540+1500+2380+1200+1740+1500+1220+1500+3080+4800+540=20000mm between measured outer wall faces (grey double-line bands). Outer faces: x px 249->0m, 610->10m; y px 152->20m (north), 877->0m (south); 27.70mm/px in x, 27.59mm/px in y. Exterior walls 240mm thick (annotated '240'); footprint points are OUTER faces. Interior partitions are drawn as thin double lines (~150-200mm, no thickness annotation); paths are measured wall CENTRELINES (V1 x px 397-403 -> centre 400; V2 x px 461-462 band -> centre 460, consistent with bottom chain 4180/1640/4180; H walls centre rows y 303/367/407/583/699/753 from grey line-pair peaks). Aperture extents are grey-interruption gaps bounded by jamb lines (cyan profiles profile_004..profile_015). Regularization: interior partition endpoints extended to the outer-face footprint boundary where they abut exterior walls (observed ink stops at inner faces).
